mapper.update: UPDATE workspaces SET trust=#{trust},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspaces WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM threads WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT thread_id,workspace_id,title,provider_id,model_id,reasoning_level,access_mode,collaboration_mode,title_source, revision,created_at,updated_at,pinned_at,archived_at,deleted_at, (SELECT state FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_turn_status, COALESCE((SELECT turn_sequence<=COALESCE(threads.last_seen_turn_sequence,0) FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1),1) AS latest_turn_seen, (SELECT goal_id FROM goals WHERE owner_thread_id=threads.thread_id AND status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','PAUSED') LIMIT 1) AS active_goal_id FROM threads WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE threads SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: UPDATE threads SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING revision
mapper.update: UPDATE threads SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT thread_id,workspace_id,title,provider_id,model_id,reasoning_level,access_mode,collaboration_mode,title_source, revision,created_at,updated_at,pinned_at,archived_at,deleted_at, (SELECT state FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_turn_status, COALESCE((SELECT turn_sequence<=COALESCE(threads.last_seen_turn_sequence,0) FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1),1) AS latest_turn_seen, (SELECT goal_id FROM goals WHERE owner_thread_id=threads.thread_id AND status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','PAUSED') LIMIT 1) AS active_goal_id FROM threads WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND archived_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM thread_lineage WHERE child_thread_id=threads.thread_id) AND ( (CASE WHEN pinned_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)<#{cursorPinned} OR ((CASE WHEN pinned_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)=#{cursorPinned} AND ( COALESCE(pinned_at,updated_at)<#{cursorSortTime} OR (COALESCE(pinned_at,updated_at)=#{cursorSortTime} AND updated_at<#{cursorUpdatedAt}) OR (COALESCE(pinned_at,updated_at)=#{cursorSortTime} AND updated_at=#{cursorUpdatedAt} AND thread_id<#{cursorId}) )) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN pinned_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, COALESCE(pinned_at,updated_at) DESC,updated_at DESC,thread_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT thread_id,workspace_id,title,provider_id,model_id,reasoning_level,access_mode,collaboration_mode,title_source, revision,created_at,updated_at,pinned_at,archived_at,deleted_at, (SELECT state FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_turn_status, COALESCE((SELECT turn_sequence<=COALESCE(threads.last_seen_turn_sequence,0) FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1),1) AS latest_turn_seen, (SELECT goal_id FROM goals WHERE owner_thread_id=threads.thread_id AND status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','PAUSED') LIMIT 1) AS active_goal_id FROM threads WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM thread_lineage WHERE child_thread_id=threads.thread_id) AND instr(lower(title),#{normalizedQuery})>0 AND (updated_at<#{cursorTime} OR (updated_at=#{cursorTime} AND thread_id<#{cursorId})) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,thread_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE threads SET provider_id=#{providerId},model_id=#{modelId},reasoning_level=#{reasoningLevel}, access_mode=#{accessMode},collaboration_mode=#{collaborationMode}, title=#{provisionalTitle}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND title_source='PLACEHOLDER'

UPDATE threads SET last_seen_turn_sequence=( SELECT turn_sequence FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1), revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (SELECT state FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') AND COALESCE(last_seen_turn_sequence,0)<( SELECT turn_sequence FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM turns WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL','SUSPENDED')

SELECT u.turn_id,u.request_id,u.model_round,u.request_ordinal,u.purpose,u.certainty, u.profile_json,u.input_tokens,u.output_tokens,u.total_tokens,u.created_at AS occurred_at FROM usage u JOIN turns x ON x.turn_id=u.turn_id WHERE u.thread_id=#{threadId} ORDER BY x.turn_sequence DESC,u.request_ordinal DESC,u.usage_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.artifact_id,a.sha256,a.content,a.byte_length FROM change_set_artifacts a JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=a.thread_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN turns x ON x.turn_id=a.turn_id AND x.thread_id=a.thread_id WHERE a.thread_id=#{threadId} AND a.turn_id=#{turnId} AND a.artifact_id=#{artifactId} AND x.state IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
